text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Beni-ss-simo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The air grows taut in anticipation of the curtain rise!
The prelude has already begun to play!
On this day, I had gone to a concert by a renowned musician with Sounds of Earth, but—

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"An announcement for our guests.
A complication has been identified regarding this performance,
and we are currently considering our options for opening the show."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable! Was this tension-filled melodia
actually an ominous melody?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: No way... Does that mean it's cancelled...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dissonance echoes throughout the venue...
Let us proceed toward the source of this unsettling sound!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind a rental suit,
we can get one for you right away, but...

text_block_list.name: Renowned Musician
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry.
I cannot perform unless I am wearing those clothes.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Is there a problem?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: H-Hold on!? Who on earth are you!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Rorchestra!!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just the orchestra members? Never mind that, the Maestro's costume
hasn't arrived yet! And it's already past showtime—!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: An outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Renowned Musician
text_block_list.text:
Call me selfish all you want, I don't care... Even so,
my music won't be complete without that outfit!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
So that's what happened."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I'm sorry, but could you please hold down the fort here for a moment!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"...Sensei, is it really impossible
to wear a different outfit...?"

text_block_list.name: Renowned Musician
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me, but please understand.
It pains me to say it, but today's concert must be canceled—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Suoniamo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I will buy us time with my performance
until the teacher's costume arrives!

text_block_list.name: Renowned Musician
text_block_list.text: You are...? And what's with that outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
This is my formal attire as a musicista!
My Racewear to play the finest musica!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The theme of my music is a jam session with the Earth.
And that theme is woven throughout my outfit as well."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"A brooch modeled after the Earth at her chest,
and an inner lining inspired by a melodia
that echoes out into the cosmos—"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To a performer, the outfit is also part of the musica...
Therefore, the music is incomplete in any other attire!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I pray that Sensei's one-of-a-kind racing uniform arrives safely... Farewell for now!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
W-Who's that...?
...Such a beautiful melody, though...

text_block_list.name: Renowned Musician
text_block_list.text: "...Magnificent. At times like a gentle breeze, at times like the mighty earth... It is truly the Earth itself!"

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
So this is what it means for the outfit to be part of the music...
I'll go back and trace where that costume went!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ......Grazie.
(Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: One more song, pleaseee!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply honored, but I am merely the prelude.
Now, how ought I to respond in a situation like this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply honored, but I am merely the prelude.
Now, how ought I to respond in a situation like this?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bravissimo!!
Then Trainer, please take hold of this!

(Shaka-shaka-shaka-shaka!
Shaka-shaka-shaka-shaka!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that wonderful!
It's a session like the Earth and the Moon!
And so, after somehow stalling for time, the musician's costume arrived safely, and the performance went off without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I see. In other words, it's a jam session with the audience—the <font>spettatori</font>!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now, play whichever songs you like!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The scaaff-fold fun has ooonly just beeguuun!
Are you reeeady yet?!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Not yet~!
And so, after somehow stalling for time, the musician's costume arrived safely, and the performance went off without a hitch.
